Maui Bicycling League Monthly Group Ride

Kihei, HI · Road · E-bike

Beginner friendly

Maui Bicycling League Monthly Group Ride is a road and e-bike group ride in Kihei, HI. Schedule: Once a month, usually a Saturday morning; location varies (e.g., Kalama Park, Kihei); registration required. About 13–40 miles, intermediate 12–14 mph, some rides with a 10–12 mph beginner option.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 12–14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @mblridealoha the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Maui Bicycling League Monthly Group Ride group ride

Maui's bike advocacy nonprofit hosts one group ride a month to bring local riders together, capped at 30 people with pre-registration. Routes change; a past one ran Kihei to Iao Valley and Wailuku with live music at the coffee stop. E-bikes welcome, helmets required.
